title: record page header ⋯ menu: the system entries (Edit, favorites, Share, Delete) carry no icons beside the app's iconed actions, and Edit has no header control when the row is full — icons on every entry, Delete last, an Edit icon button beside the ⋯
body:
Filing gate ③, on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, finding F10, figure 19), listed this as a proposed card, and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444. Follows #12427 (the favorites entry in this menu). Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, the header items at lines 3084–3180), size S.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "record header overflow menu items missing icons Edit only reachable from more menu edit button record detail header" → 7, all closed: #11684, #7281, #7244 (the title chip's width), #4296 (the kebab's grants), #4192 (`action:menu`'s payload), #1002 (duplicate header buttons), #874. None is this card.

## What happens

On the HotCRM lead page at 1440 the header's ⋯ menu lists, in order: Log a Meeting (calendar icon), Schedule a Meeting (calendar icon), Edit, Add to favorites, Share, Delete (red). The two app actions carry the icons their metadata declares; the four system entries carry none, so the menu reads as two lists. Edit is the only edit control in the header: the page's edit affordances are the inline pencils on the highlight strip and on each section's fields, and Edit itself sits three rows down inside ⋯ beside Delete.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` lines 3084–3100: `sys_edit` (`order: 100`, `locations: ['record_header']`, `variant: 'default'`, rendered through the header's overflow when the app's own actions fill the header row); line 3120: `sys_favorite` (`order: 105`, `component: 'action:menu'`); line 3133: `sys_share` (`order: 110`); line 3169: `sys_delete` (`order: 120`). None of the four sets `icon`; the app's actions (HotCRM `log_meeting`, `schedule_meeting`) do, and the menu draws an icon when the action declares one.
2. Browser reading (1440): header row = Convert Lead · Schedule Follow-up · Log a Call · ⋯ · refresh; the ⋯ holds the two remaining app actions and the four system entries in the order above.

## What to build

1. The four system entries declare icons from the lucide set the console already uses (pencil for Edit, star for favorites, share for Share, trash for Delete), through the same `icon` key the app's actions use, so the menu draws one kind of row.
2. Delete is separated from the rest by a menu separator and stays last; Edit leads the system group.
3. When `sys_edit` is folded into ⋯ because the header row is full, the header keeps an icon-only Edit button (pencil, `aria-label` 「Edit」) beside the ⋯, so editing is one click from the header at every width where the row is full. When the row has room, today's Edit button stays as it is.

## Acceptance

- `RecordDetailView` tests: the overflow's four system items each carry an icon; Delete is last and after a separator; with three app actions in the header, an Edit icon button is rendered beside the ⋯ and opens the edit session the `sys_edit` item opens.
- Browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on the HotCRM lead: every ⋯ entry has an icon; a pencil button sits beside the ⋯.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (patch) for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Out of scope

- The highlight strip's inline pencil; the record form; the actions' order relative to app actions beyond "system group after app actions".

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
